propositions: The eval/calibration library surface does not admit activated project code-review criteria; _code_review_prompt_id only recognizes built-in physical ids without repository context.
calibrate_criterion maps non-physical ids through the default plan-review namespace and has no code-review membership branch.
_code_review_prompt_id must accept repo_root as optional keyword argument and admit both built-in physical ids and logical ids from code_review.registry.effective_criteria when repo_root is provided.

calibrate_criterion must select the code-review arm when repo_root is not None and criterion_id is in code_review.registry.effective_criteria, resolving with criterion_prompt_id(criterion_id, gate_key='code_review').
EvalError raised from load_eval_spec in the code-review arm must be re-raised with located error information including logical criterion_id.
Backward compatibility must be preserved: _code_review_prompt_id without repo_root admits built-in ids, and plan-review criteria with non-None repo_root follow unchanged calibration path.
